records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 28.0 percent in the third quarter of 2021 compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase resulted primarily from increases in revenue per shipment and tonnage.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 82.8 percent in the third quarter of 2021 compared to 88.5 percent in the third quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The improved operating ratio compared to prior year is due to the Company’s continued focus on pricing initiatives, cost control and operating efficiencies.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $106.1 million for the third quarter of 2021 compared to $55.2 million for the third quarter of 2020.
